body:
Measured in the 2026-09-20 long-session benchmark: the engine daemon's live heap is flat at 3-4 MB (gctrace via host.log) while its RSS creeps about 200 KB per turn early in a session, decaying to 20-50 KB per turn later. Freed pages staying resident, not a leak, but the high-water mark climbs.

One contributor is per-turn churn: a trivial turn makes 5 provider calls (2 reflex + 2 router + 1 turn, title once per session), each with its own request, response and parse allocations.

Worth a look at: trimming per-turn allocations on the hot path, and whether the reflex and router fan-out can share work. The call count is also a latency and per-task-cost question, not only memory.

—
